चत् CAT, only pr. pt. cátat and pp. cattá, 🞄hide (int.);
 cs. cātáya, drive away. pra, vi, 🞄cs. Ā. id..
चतसृ cátasṛ or catasṛ́, f. of catur.
चतुःक catuḥ-ka, -pa, v. चतुष्क catuṣ-ka, 🞄-pa, etc..
चतुर् catúr, num. m. n. pl. four.
चतुरक्ष catur-akṣá, a. (ī́) four-eyed.

चतुरक्षर cátur-akṣara, a. having four syllables;
 🞄n. aggregate of four syllables.
चतुरङ्गिन् catur-aṅgin, a. consisting of four 🞄parts.
चतुरता catura-tā, f. cleverness, craftiness, 🞄shrewdness.
चतुर्गुण cátur-guṇa, a. fourfold.

चातुर्थ cāturtha, a. discussed in the fourth 🞄(chapter): -ka, a. occurring every fourth day 🞄(fever);
 -ahnika, a. belonging to the fourth 🞄day.
चतुर्थीकर्मन् caturthī-karman, n. ceremony 🞄of the fourth wedding day.
चतुर्दन्त catur-danta, m. N. of an elephant.

चतुश्चत्वारिंश catuś-catvāriṃśá, a. (ī,) forty fourth;
 🞄cátuś-catvārṃśat, f. forty-four.

चतुष्किका catuṣk-ikā, f. tetrad;
 hall resting 🞄on four pillars.
चतुस् catús, ad. four times.
चतूरात्र catū-rātrá, four days: -m, ac. for 🞄four days.
चत्वर catvar-á, m. n. square, courtyard.
चत्वार् catvā́r, str. st. of catur, m. n. pl. four.
चातक cātaka, m., ī, f. kind of cuckoo (supposed 🞄to live on drops of rain only).
चातन cāt-ana, cs. a. driving away (—˚).
चातुर्धाकारणिक cāturdhā-kāraṇika, a. divided 🞄into four parts.

चातुर्य cātur-ya, n. skill, dexterity;
 charm.

चातुष्पथ cātuṣ-patha, a. being at a place 🞄where four roads meet;
 -prāśyá, a. sufficient 🞄to feed four.
चात्त्र cāt-tra, n. spindle (esp. that in which 🞄is fixed the drill (pramantha) for producing the 🞄sacred fire by means of a cord wound round it 🞄and rapidly worked backwards and forwards).
